name: Rise of Mutant Swarms
storyline:
A quiet research zone has been overrun by mysterious mutant creatures. What begins as a small outbreak quickly becomes a growing threat as the creatures evolve and become stronger with every wave.

As the Commander, players must build defenses, survive the attacks, and investigate the source of the mutation.

Evidence eventually reveals a failed secret experiment deep within the forest caused the outbreak.

Now, the mission is clear: contain the swarm, destroy the mutation source, and stop the threat from spreading.

The swarm is evolving. Your strategy must evolve faster.
summary: Rise of Mutant Swarms is a strategy survival tower-defense game where you defend the base against waves of evolving mutant enemies. Place and upgrade turrets, adapt to enemy abilities, and make critical decisions as the pressure rises with every wave.
